provenance: Stage-2 lane split applying the decision-agent's documented routing rule (detect-vs-hunt by detection feasibility, not severity: low=hunt, medium/high=detect) deterministically from each TTP's Stage-1 detection_feasibility assessment. Partition validated to cover the Stage-1 seed exactly with no overlap/dup; all ids verified present in the CI's bundled ATT&CK dataset.

detection_candidates.rationale: medium — keylogging hook installation and the associated backdoor process behavior can surface via EDR API-hook/process telemetry and file-write patterns for keystroke logs, but keylogging itself produces limited discrete host signal without endpoint instrumentation

medium — creation of .cab archives staging heterogeneous collected data (images, audio, logs, documents) in unusual locations is observable via file-write and process command-line telemetry and makes a workable hunt for staging-before-exfil behavior

hunting_candidates.rationale: low — clipboard access uses standard OS APIs and generates little distinguishing telemetry; hunt candidate via process behavior correlation on the backdoor rather than a standalone signal

low — periodic screen/webcam capture by a background process is difficult to distinguish from legitimate software; hunt candidate via image-file staging and camera-device access correlated to the backdoor process
low — microphone access via standard multimedia APIs yields minimal discrete telemetry; hunt candidate via audio-file staging and microphone-device access tied to an untrusted process
low — enumerating window titles uses benign Windows APIs common to legitimate software; not independently detectable, hunt only as part of backdoor process behavior

low — device-arrival monitoring and printer/peripheral enumeration use standard OS notifications common to legitimate drivers and utilities; hunt candidate via correlation with the backdoor and unexpected access to print-spool artifacts
low — system-enumeration API calls are ubiquitous and generate little distinguishing signal; hunt only within backdoor process context
